payload.name: Jokes to Code
payload.description: Collection of jokes for systematic humor analysis coding
payload.content:
1. Why do programmers prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs.

2. A SQL query walks into a bar, walks up to two tables and asks in a loud voice: "Can I join you?"

3. Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.

4. Two antennas got married. The ceremony wasn't much, but the reception was excellent.

5. Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.

6. Why did the developer go broke? Because he used up all his cache.

7. A man tells his doctor, "Help me. I'm addicted to Twitter!" The doctor replies, "Sorry, I don't follow you."

8. A priest, a rabbi, and a minister walk into a bar. The bartender says, "What is this, a joke?"

9. I'm reading a book on the history of glue – can't put it down.

10. Why did the Python programmer go to therapy? He had too many issues to debug.

11. I told my computer I needed a break. Now it won't stop sending me Kit-Kat ads.

12. I used to play piano by ear, but now I use my hands.

13. What do you call a fish wearing a bowtie? Sofishticated.

14. Why did the AI not cooperate? Because it took the prompt too seriously.

15. Debugging: Like being the detective in a crime drama where you are also the murderer.
